text: 🇺🇦 The largest metallurgical plant in Ukraine, "ArcelorMittal," is beginning the process of completely shutting down production, followed by the preservation of its facilities. This was announced by the company. The reason for this is four missile attacks, which resulted in the deaths of six employees, more than 18 injuries, and the shutdown of the main metallurgical production. The process of cold shutdown will take approximately two months. The company hopes to resume operations after the end of the war. "Based on our current assessment, safe operation is impossible as long as the war continues," said Mauro Longobardo, CEO of the company. 🐻 Notice how that's not a very common Ukrainian name 🔴 @DDGeopolitics
text_zh: 🇺🇦 乌克兰最大的冶金厂“安赛乐米塔尔”（ArcelorMittal）正开始全面停产，随后将对其设施进行封存。这是该公司宣布的。原因是四次导弹袭击，导致六名员工死亡，超过18人受伤，并导致主要冶金生产线停产。冷停机过程大约需要两个月。该公司希望在战争结束后恢复运营。公司首席执行官毛罗·隆戈巴多（Mauro Longobardo）表示：“根据我们目前的评估，只要战争持续，安全运营是不可能的。” 🐻 注意，这并不是一个常见的乌克兰名字 🔴 @DDGeopolitics

text: ↩️ Reply to OSINT Nuno Felix Yeah…. Oust Zelensky and get this guy or Budanov as President. That will go great for Russia….. I am grateful to the UK government for its consistently clear and uncompromising stance on exerting pressure on Russia. London once again proves that it remains a loyal and reliable ally of Ukraine that understands the international situation and is fully aware of all the strategic risks posed by Russia's actions and the easing of sanctions against it. Every day, Russians kill Ukrainians and destroy our peaceful cities and civilian infrastructure. Russia's entire state mechanism is currently geared exclusively toward an aggressive war. Putin’s only logic is to continue the aggression as long as he has the resources to do so and until he is stopped by force. Easing economic and sanctions pressure on Russia would only encourage further escalation, which could very easily and quickly spread beyond Ukraine and beyond Europe. Such an easing of pressure cannot be justified by anything – neither by business logic nor by political declarations. It is not acceptable to negotiate with the aggressor at the expense of Ukrainian lives – this is fuel that will ignite an even greater war. I thank Prime Minister Andy Burnham and all the people of the United Kingdom for their solidarity and steadfast support for Ukraine in our struggle. - Valerii Zaluzhnyi tweet
text_zh: ↩️ 回复 OSINT Nuno Felix 是的……罢免泽连斯基，让这家伙或布达诺夫（Budanov）当总统。这对俄罗斯来说会很棒……我感谢英国政府在对俄罗斯施压问题上始终保持明确和不妥协的立场。伦敦再次证明，它仍然是乌克兰忠诚可靠的盟友，它了解国际局势，并充分意识到俄罗斯的行为及其放宽制裁所带来的所有战略风险。俄罗斯人每天都在杀害乌克兰人，摧毁我们和平的城市和民用基础设施。俄罗斯的国家机器目前完全是为了侵略战争而运作的。普京唯一的逻辑就是只要他有资源，并且在被武力阻止之前，就会继续侵略。放宽对俄罗斯的经济和制裁压力只会鼓励进一步升级，这很容易且迅速地蔓延到乌克兰之外和欧洲之外。这种压力缓解在任何方面都是无法辩解的——无论是从商业逻辑还是政治声明来看。以牺牲乌克兰人的生命为代价与侵略者谈判是不可接受的——这是点燃更大战争的燃料。我感谢安迪·伯纳姆（Andy Burnham）首相和全体英国人民在我们的斗争中对乌克兰的声援和坚定支持。 - 瓦列里·扎卢日内（Valerii Zaluzhnyi）推文

text: Nuno Felix RT @ralexdc : NEW!! Pence blasts decision to lift sanctions on Russian energy, calling it a “betrayal” of Lindsey Graham’s legacy. “As I saw firsthand in Ukraine last month, Putin is losing this war,” Pence says, warning, “America should not be throwing a lifeline to Putin’s war machine” 👇 President Trump’s decision to lift sanctions on Russian fuel amidst Putin’s ongoing and brutal attacks on civilian targets in Ukraine makes no sense and is a betrayal of the legacy and leadership of the late Senator Lindsey Graham. While Ukraine fights for its survival, Putin’s war machine continues to prosecute his terrorist war on civilian populations and innocent Ukrainians are dying every day. Now, Instead of implementing the tough sanctions Lindsey Graham fought to his last breath to enact, President Trump has announced the United States is lifting sanctions on Russian energy, fueling the Putin’s war machine. As I saw firsthand in Ukraine last month, Putin is losing this war. Ukraine has fought the Russian military to a standstill and reinvented warfare with drones taking the fight into the heart of Russia. America should not be throwing a lifeline to Putin’s war machine. Now is the time to stand strong against Russian aggression as we did during the first Trump administration. Putin doesn’t want peace. Putin wants Ukraine. I have no doubt that if Putin overruns Ukraine, it will only be a matter of time until Russia’s military crosses a border that our troops will have to deal with him. America is the Leader of the Free World. For our National Security, for the security of our Allies in Europe including Ukraine, President Trump should rescind this deal immediately and return to the strong policies of our four years in the White House; impose harsh sanctions on any nation purchasing Russian energy and work with our allies to ensure Ukraine has the military support it needs to repel and defeat this Russian invasion once and for all. Slava Ukraini 🇺🇸 🇺🇦 - Mike Pence tweet
text_zh: Nuno Felix 转推 @ralexdc：最新消息！！彭斯抨击解除对俄罗斯能源制裁的决定，称其为对林赛·格雷厄姆（Lindsey Graham）遗产的“背叛”。“正如我上个月在乌克兰亲眼所见，普京正在输掉这场战争，”彭斯说，并警告称，“美国不应该给普京的战争机器提供生命线” 👇 特朗普总统在普京持续对乌克兰平民目标进行残酷袭击的情况下，决定解除对俄罗斯燃料的制裁，这毫无道理，是对已故参议员林赛·格雷厄姆的遗产和领导力的背叛。当乌克兰为生存而战时，普京的战争机器继续对平民人口进行恐怖战争，无辜的乌克兰人每天都在死去。现在，特朗普总统没有实施林赛·格雷厄姆拼死争取实施的严厉制裁，反而宣布美国正在解除对俄罗斯能源的制裁，为普京的战争机器提供燃料。正如我上个月在乌克兰亲眼所见，普京正在输掉这场战争。乌克兰已将俄罗斯军队逼入僵局，并以无人机将战斗带入俄罗斯腹地的方式重塑了战争。美国不应该给普京的战争机器提供生命线。现在是像我们在特朗普第一任期内那样，坚定反对俄罗斯侵略的时候了。普京不想要和平。普京想要乌克兰。我毫不怀疑，如果普京占领了乌克兰，俄罗斯军队越过我们的军队必须应对的边界只是时间问题。美国是自由世界的领袖。为了我们的国家安全，为了包括乌克兰在内的欧洲盟友的安全，特朗普总统应立即撤销这项协议，并回到我们在白宫四年期间的强硬政策；对任何购买俄罗斯能源的国家实施严厉制裁，并与我们的盟友合作，确保乌克兰拥有击退并彻底击败俄罗斯入侵所需的军事支持。荣耀属于乌克兰 🇺🇸 🇺🇦 - 迈克·彭斯（Mike Pence）推文

text: 🔄 Forwarded from Uncle Hoz in Tehran: Uncle Hoz in Tehran #1 Pakistan, Imran Khan & the Betrayal of Iran and Yemen. Chapters 00:00 Introduction to Pakistan and Imran Khan 01:13 The Yemen Conflict and Saudi Arabia's Role 04:59 Pakistan's Military and Its Relationship with Saudi Arabia 10:20 Iran's Resilience Against American Aggression 15:33 Betrayal of Iran by Pakistan 19:54 The Pakistani Military's Alignment with Israel 23:51 Conclusion: A Call for Unity and Integrity What happens when a country's political and military leadership appears to move in a direction that conflicts with the convictions of its own people? In this episode, I explain why I believe Pakistan's relationship with Saudi Arabia, the war in Yemen, and the treatment of Imran Khan raise some fundamental questions about sovereignty, political integrity, and solidarity with Palestine. I discuss: Imran Khan ( @ImranKhanPTI ): Why I admire his stated commitment to peace and better relations with Iran and Russia. Pakistan's military establishment: My concerns about its political role and its relationship with Saudi Arabia. Yemen and Palestine: Why I believe the people who stand up for Palestine should not be abandoned when the pressure comes. Iran: My perspective on Iranian resilience, sovereignty, and the consequences of foreign intervention. A question of principle: Can governments claim to represent their people while pursuing policies that contradict their convictions? I have a deep respect for the Pakistani people. My criticism is directed at the leadership and the decisions being made in their name, not at ordinary Pakistanis. For me, this is ultimately about integrity, independence, and refusing to abandon people facing oppression. Watch the full discussion and let me know what you think in the comments. If you believe these conversations matter, share this video. #Pakistan #ImranKhan #Iran #Yemen #Palestine #Geopolitics

text: Open Source Intel Latest Houthi attack: Riyadh International Airport WHAT WE KNOW SO FAR A Houthi missile struck the complex housing Terminals 3 and 4 (domestic flights) at King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh on Saturday. The attack is attributed to the Houthis, but they have not claimed it yet, unlike their earlier strikes this week. Time: Approximately 3:00 PM local time. Saudi Arabia's early warning system issued no alert before impact. Casualties: Dozens injured, including several pilgrims traveling to Mecca. A hospital source told AFP that 5 people are in intensive care. No fatalities have been confirmed yet. Airport terminals were evacuated and operations suspended. Health authorities called in doctors for a mass casualty emergency. Numerous flights were canceled or diverted, with 266 canceled and 219 delayed. Several international airlines suspended Riyadh flights, including Lufthansa Group (through October 16), Air India, Flydubai, Pakistan International and Kuwait Airways. The US, Canadian and other embassies told citizens to stay away from the airport. This is the third attack on the airport this week. Thursday's strike killed 3 Saudis, including Saudia pilot Captain Hamoud Ali Alkalthami, and hit a parked Saudia jet. Wednesday's attack killed a Sudanese national. Total confirmed deaths at Riyadh and Abha airports this week: 6. Saudi authorities have warned residents that filming or sharing interceptions or impact sites could bring legal action. Europe's aviation safety agency (EASA) expanded its warning on Saudi airspace, citing the Houthis' growing focus on airports. tweet
text_zh: Open Source Intel 胡塞武装最新袭击：利雅得国际机场。目前已知情况：周六，一枚胡塞武装导弹击中了利雅得哈立德国王国际机场的3号和4号航站楼（国内航班）所在的建筑群。袭击被归咎于胡塞武装，但与本周早些时候的袭击不同，他们尚未认领此次袭击。时间：当地时间下午3:00左右。沙特阿拉伯的预警系统在撞击前未发出警报。伤亡：数十人受伤，包括几名前往麦加的朝圣者。一位医院消息人士告诉法新社，有5人在重症监护室。目前尚未确认有死亡人数。机场航站楼已疏散，运营暂停。卫生部门召集医生应对大规模伤亡紧急情况。大量航班被取消或改道，其中266个航班取消，219个延误。多家国际航空公司暂停了飞往利雅得的航班，包括汉莎航空集团（至10月16日）、印度航空、迪拜航空、巴基斯坦国际航空和科威特航空。美国、加拿大和其他大使馆告知公民远离机场。这是本周第三次袭击该机场。周四的袭击造成3名沙特人死亡，其中包括沙特航空飞行员哈穆德·阿里·阿尔卡塔米机长，并击中了一架停放的沙特航空喷气式飞机。周三的袭击造成一名苏丹国民死亡。本周利雅得和艾卜哈机场确认的死亡总人数为：6人。沙特当局警告居民，拍摄或分享拦截情况或撞击现场可能会招致法律诉讼。欧洲航空安全局（EASA）扩大了对沙特领空的警告，理由是胡塞武装对机场的关注日益增加。推文

text: U.S. negotiators offered Russia three major economic incentives in exchange for a limited cease-fire covering energy infrastructure or maritime operations. The proposals included releasing billions in frozen Russian sovereign assets, potentially reviving an earlier plan involving up to $100 billion. Washington also revisited a multibillion-dollar deal to sell parts of Russian oil giant Lukoil to Middle Eastern investors, some with business ties to U.S. negotiators, and a proposal allowing Belarus to export potash. Ukraine did not reject the proposals outright but demanded safeguards, including matching payments from frozen Russian assets to Ukraine and additional military aid if Moscow violated a truce. Source: NYT
text_zh: 美国谈判代表向俄罗斯提供了三项主要的经济激励措施，以换取涵盖能源基础设施或海上行动的有限停火。这些提议包括解冻数十亿美元的俄罗斯主权资产，并可能重启一项涉及高达1000亿美元的早期计划。华盛顿还重新审视了一项价值数十亿美元的交易，即向中东投资者出售俄罗斯石油巨头卢克石油公司（Lukoil）的部分股份，其中一些投资者与美国谈判代表有业务往来，此外还有一项允许白俄罗斯出口钾肥的提议。乌克兰并未直接拒绝这些提议，但要求提供保障措施，包括从冻结的俄罗斯资产中向乌克兰支付对等款项，以及如果莫斯科违反停火协议，则提供额外的军事援助。来源：纽约时报
